caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with four drawers arranged vertically. The chest is rendered in shades of reddish-brown, simulating wood grain, and features detailed gold or yellowish inlay outlining the drawer fronts and the top edge. Each drawer is fitted with two oval-shaped brass or gold-colored handles with decorative backplates. There are also small round keyholes in the center of each drawer. The legs of the chest are short and shaped with a slight inward curve, creating a bracket foot style. The background of the drawing is plain and cream-colored, with no additional objects present, and the artist’s name "Arthur Johnson" is written in small text in the lower left corner.
title: Chest of Drawers
